The summary already excludes implementer self-review, binds required independent assessment to the shared owner, and preserves the exact durable trace and domain applicability. It imposes no generic contributor disclosure duty. Keep the body under the clarified owner; this is a bounded author comparison.

Discovery binds exact governing basis and existing authority, preserves applicable prior judgments, and re-enters source when the projection is insufficient. It makes no forced Intent-reprice or blanket stale-support decision, no contributor disclosure duty, and no ban on lawful recheck. Its body remains applicable under the changed owners; complete compression qualification remains open.
